## Summary

- Adds a `preview` label gate: adding the `preview` label to any issue triggers a Surge.sh deployment after the agent commits changes
- `agent-implement.yml`: check label → build (`npm ci` + `npx quartz build`) → deploy to `augmented-mind-preview-<N>.surge.sh` → surface URL in the Sepo status comment
- `agent-fix-pr.yml`: symmetric support — extracts the issue number from the branch name, checks the same label, and redeploys after fix-pr commits so the preview stays current
- `agent-branch-cleanup.yml`: new `teardown-preview` job fires on any PR close (merge or decline) and calls `npx surge teardown` to clean up stale previews
- `response.ts` + `post-comment.ts`: `previewUrl` field added to `StatusCommentData`; rendered as `- Preview: <url>` in the implement comment and `Preview: <url>` in the fix-pr comment

## Setup required

Add two repo secrets before first use:
- `SURGE_LOGIN` — your Surge account email
- `SURGE_TOKEN` — token from `npx surge token` (requires `npm install -g surge` + `surge login`)

## Test plan

- [ ] Add `preview` label to a test issue, trigger `/implement`, verify preview URL appears in the Sepo comment
- [ ] Trigger `/fix-pr` on the resulting PR, verify the preview URL is updated in the PR comment
- [ ] Merge or close the PR, verify the `teardown-preview` job runs and the URL goes dark
- [ ] Trigger `/implement` on an issue without the `preview` label, verify no surge steps run

Closes #50

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. ## Summary of PR/Issue PR #52 adds label-gated Surge.sh preview deployments to the agent automation pipeline. When an issue has the `preview` label, running `/implement` builds the Quartz site and deploys to `augmented-mind-preview-.surge.sh`, surfacing the URL in the Sepo status comment. The `fix-pr` workflow mirrors this behavior, redeploying after commits. A new `teardown-preview` job in `agent-branch-cleanup.yml` fires on PR close and calls `surge teardown` to clean up stale previews. The `StatusCommentData` interface and both comment formatters are extended with an optional `previewUrl` field. Two secrets (`SURGE_LOGIN`, `SURGE_TOKEN`) are required before first use. ## Review The feature is correct and complete — the label gate, per-issue URL scheme, symmetric implement/fix-pr coverage, and teardown-on-close all match the plan agreed in issue #50. Two workflow issues should be fixed before the label sees regular use: an unnecessary checkout+auth step in teardown, and a missing `issues: read` permission in fix-pr that causes a silent failure with the `github.token` fallback. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | Unused auth in `teardown-preview` | WARNING | `checkout@v4` and `resolve-github-auth` are present but `steps.auth.outputs.token` is never used; only `SURGE_LOGIN`/`SURGE_TOKEN` are needed. | | Missing `issues: read` in `agent-fix-pr.yml` | WARNING | The new label-check step calls `gh issue view` but the workflow's `permissions` block lacks `issues: read`; with the `github.token` fallback this fails silently and no preview is deployed. | | Uncached `npm ci` in deploy steps | INFO | Both deploy steps run `npm ci` without a cache layer, adding ~30–60 s per preview run. | | `SURGE_LOGIN` likely unused for teardown | INFO | `surge teardown` only uses `--token`; the env var appears to be a no-op for this subcommand. | | No tests for `previewUrl` branches | INFO | The `if (data.previewUrl)` guard in `formatImplementComment`/`formatFixPrComment` is untested; coverage is low-risk but easy to add. | ## Progress - Design matches issue #50 plan exactly — no scope deviations flagged. - `.agent/dist/` correctly excluded from the PR (gitignored; rebuilt at runtime via `setup-agent-runtime`). - Rubrics not yet initialized for this repo (`agent/rubrics` branch absent); no rubric-specific findings. - PR description documents the two required secrets clearly. ## Issue Details
Unused auth in teardown-preview **Cause:** The `teardown-preview` job was likely scaffolded from the `cleanup` job above it, which does need `steps.auth.outputs.token` (passed to `actions/github-script`). The teardown job only runs a shell command using `SURGE_LOGIN`/`SURGE_TOKEN` and never references the auth output. **Candidate solutions:** - Remove the `uses: actions/checkout@v4` step and the `Resolve GitHub auth` step entirely. The `teardown-preview` job runs on `ubuntu-latest` with no local composite action; no checkout is needed. **Comments:** Harmless in practice (`continue-on-error: true` on the teardown step), but adds unnecessary checkout time on every PR close.
Missing issues: read in agent-fix-pr.yml **Cause:** The `permissions` block (`actions: write`, `contents: write`, `pull-requests: write`, `id-token: write`) was not updated when the label-check step was added. `agent-implement.yml` already has `issues: write` but `agent-fix-pr.yml` does not. **Candidate solutions:** - Add `issues: read` to the `permissions` block in `agent-fix-pr.yml` (line 101–105 in the current file). **Comments:** Works fine when the app token or PAT is available (both carry broader issue access). The failure mode is silent only with the `github.token` fallback — `LABELS` returns empty, `DEPLOY_PREVIEW` is never set, and the preview silently skips with no log message.
Uncached npm ci in deploy steps **Cause:** Both deploy steps run a bare `npm ci` from the Quartz project root with no `actions/cache` or `setup-node cache: 'npm'` wrapper. **Candidate solutions:** - Add `actions/setup-node` with `cache: 'npm'` before the deploy steps, or add an explicit `actions/cache` step for `~/.npm`. **Comments:** Not a blocker. The cost is ~30–60 s per preview-label run and only matters on busy repos.
## Recommended Next Step `FIX_PR` — the two WARNING findings are concrete, safe, one-line workflow changes (remove two steps from `teardown-preview`; add `issues: read` to `agent-fix-pr.yml`) that can be applied in an automated fix-pr pass. ## Final Verdict `MINOR_ISSUES` ## Action Items - [ ] Remove the `uses: actions/checkout@v4` step and `Resolve GitHub auth` step from the `teardown-preview` job in `.github/workflows/agent-branch-cleanup.yml` — neither is used by that job. - [ ] Add `issues: read` to the `permissions` block in `.github/workflows/agent-fix-pr.yml` to prevent silent failure of the label-check step when `github.token` is the active credential. --- **Inline comments posted:** 2 - `.github/workflows/agent-branch-cleanup.yml` line 98: unused `resolve-github-auth` in teardown-preview - `.github/workflows/agent-fix-pr.yml` line 169: missing `issues: read` for `gh issue view` call
